title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: When a player gets hurt
hook: A player is hit by a pitch and does not get up right away.
statement: Calm adults help kids stay calm.
q1: Do you have a set plan for who does what —
q2: or handle each injury as it comes?
q3: Who in your dugout has first aid training?
t1: There is no single right way. But injuries go smoother
t2: when the adults already know their roles.
cta: Coaches — what is your injury plan?
ctaLines: First aid kit. A parent with training. Call the family.
A plan or handle it as it comes?
ctaPrompt: Share your safety habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player is hit by a pitch and does not get up right away.
The game stops. Everyone is looking at you.
Calm adults help kids stay calm.
A set plan or handle it as it comes. There is no perfect answer.
What is your injury plan? Share your habit in the comments.
